about_the_game:
Welcome to Ashen Wilds—a harsh, post-apocalyptic world full of danger, mystery, and tough choices.
Whether you play solo or with friends, your main goal is simple: survive. But getting there? Not so easy.

In this open world survival game, you’ll need to:

  • Gather resources like wood, food, and metals to stay alive.

  • Craft tools, weapons, and gear to defend yourself and expand your base.

  • Build your own fortress to protect yourself from the wild—and from other survivors.

  • Fight terrifying creatures, especially dangerous at night.

  • Encounter other players—but beware: not everyone is friendly.

Whether you create your own story or team up with others, your choices will shape your fate in Ashen Wilds.

Key Features:

  • 🛠️ Deep crafting system – from simple tools to high-tech defenses.

  • 🧱 Custom base building – design and fortify your base the way you want.

  • ⚔️ Dangerous PvPvE environment – battle against creatures and rival survivors.

  • 🌍 Dynamic open world – including weather effects, day/night cycle, and hidden locations.

  • 🤝 Co-op and PvP gameplay – go solo, team up, or compete against others.

  • 🔓 Unlockable skills & gear – progress and improve as you survive.
